requirements: Use the actual OpenCode runtime to read the fixture file and report its marker.
cases.prompt: Use the native read tool once to read runtime-proof.txt in this workspace. Report the exact marker found in its contents.
cases.trap: Claiming to have read the file without a successful observed read.
expectations: The runtime read tool returns the expected marker.
The final response reports the exact marker from the observed read result.
must_not: Claims the file was read if no successful native read is observed.
